druid-of-the-claw.title: Druid of the Claw notes
items: Make a {Ravage} with your first {Tiger's Fury} after combat starts, and stack {Ravage} into {Berserk} / {Convoke the Spirits} windows
Push dangerous add packs with {Typhoon} and hold them with {Incapacitating Roar} (both boss immune)

[광역 피해] Line up Tiger's Fury (30 sec) with every Ssscavenging shield, and stack Berserk and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) on whichever shield they are ready for

[광역 피해] During Uncoil, spread Rip to all five Writhes with Primal Wrath and use Berserk and Convoke the Spirits in this window
[해제] Clear the stacking Spiteful Venom poison on Spiteful Hunt targets with Remove Corruption, and drop Ursol's Vortex (1 min) under the Writhes chasing them to slow them down
Zul'jan: [위치] If your beam spot is far away, use Dash or Tiger Dash (Druid of the Claw) to get there before Ritual of the Fang
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin (12 sec) for the 8 sec channel where you block a Ritual of the Fang beam (38793 Nature every 1 sec), and use Survival Instincts (3 min, 6 sec) on a Ritual where Barkskin is down

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation, so kick it whenever Skull Bash (15 sec) is ready

[광역 피해] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec, so go in with Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec) up. If Barkskin is down, use Survival Instincts
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [참고] If Bloodthorn Roots holds you, re-enter Cat Form to break it (Wowhead)
[회피] If you are the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, open distance for 10 sec with Dash or Tiger Dash (Druid of the Claw)
[광역 피해] Save Survival Instincts for Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Skull Bash (15 sec) in the interrupt rotation for Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature), which repeats on the tank during Moonkin Form
[참고] If you get a Pulverizing Strikes mark with Grievous Thrash still bleeding, cast an instant Regrowth from Predatory Swiftness on yourself to top off before the cone and pop Barkskin
[광역 피해] Use Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before they revive with Skull Bash
[제어] If Lashers are grouped before reviving, delay their casts with Incapacitating Roar. Revived Lashers are immune to CC

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Remove the Toxic Spores poison stacked from Spoiled Supplies mushrooms with Remove Corruption, starting with whoever stomped the most (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for the raid-wide Ravenous Bellow damage

[위치] Before Frozen Tempest, use Stampeding Roar to move the party into Snowdrift quickly
Nalorakk: [위치] When you are targeted by Echoing Maul, pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec) and use Dash to reach this set's assigned corner within 4 sec
[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, block Echoes with your body and pop Barkskin or Survival Instincts

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Line up Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits all with the 20 sec Destabilized window
[차단] Kick one Mirror Images clone's Felstorm with Skull Bash, and use Incapacitating Roar on grouped clones
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The fight opens with the worker pack after the RP and is the second Bloodlust window, so stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits and spread Rip to the workers and the boss with Primal Wrath

391881.d: 도려내기로 피해를 입히면 4.0%의 확률로 다음 흉포한 이빨이 자원을 소모하지 않고 최대 피해를 입힙니다.

400320.d: 자신의 지속 피해 효과가 피해를 입히는 주기가 20%만큼, 지속 치유 효과의 생명력을 회복시키는 주기가 15%만큼 짧아집니다.

439528.d:
도려내기 및 갈퀴 발톱으로 피해를 주면 일정 확률로 대상에게 피바라미 덩굴이 자라나 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 97.5%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

급속 성장 및 재생으로 생명력을 회복시키면 일정 확률로 대상에게 공생체 꽃이 자라나 6초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 219.6%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

이 효과는 중첩 가능합니다.

439890.d:
호랑이의 분노 및 숨기 상태로 공격 시 6초 동안 칼날 발톱, 갈퀴 발톱, 휘둘러치기의 치명타 및 극대화로 적중할 확률이 8%만큼 증가합니다.

주기적인 치유 효과가 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘할 확률이 4%만큼 증가합니다.

439926.d:
도려내기 및 흉포한 이빨의 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

회복의 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

440117.d: 피바라미 덩굴 또는 공생체 꽃이 자라나면 30%의 확률로 주위의 유효한 대상에게 같은 유형의 성장물이 즉시 자라납니다.

440120.d:
피바라미 덩굴이 만료되거나 대상에게 흉포한 이빨을 사용하면 가시 폭발을 일으켜 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 100%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

공생체 꽃이 만료되거나 대상에게 회복을 시전하면 대상 주위로 꽃이 자라나 대상과 최대 3명의 주위 아군을 (주문력의 42.09%)만큼 치유합니다.

441583.d:
자동 공격 시 일정 확률로 다음 흉포한 이빨이 찢어발기기로 전환됩니다.

찢어발기기
넓은 호를 그리며 대상을 베어버리는 마무리 일격을 날립니다. 대상에게 연계 점수에 따라 물리 피해를 입히며, 최대 25의 기력을 추가로 소모해 최대 100%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 전방의 다른 모든 적에게도 적중해 소모한 연계 점수 1점당 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 1점: [(전투력의 204.16%) / 5]의 피해, 부채꼴 범위에 [(전투력의 84.46%) / 5]의 피해
연계 점수 2점: [(전투력의 204.16%) * 2 / 5]의 피해, 부채꼴 범위에 [(전투력의 84.46%) * 2 / 5]의 피해
연계 점수 3점: [(전투력의 204.16%) * 3 / 5]의 피해, 부채꼴 범위에 [(전투력의 84.46%) * 3 / 5]의 피해
연계 점수 4점: [(전투력의 204.16%) * 4 / 5]의 피해, 부채꼴 범위에 [(전투력의 84.46%) * 4 / 5]의 피해
연계 점수 5점: [(전투력의 204.16%) * 5 / 5]의 피해, 부채꼴 범위에 [(전투력의 84.46%) * 5 / 5]의 피해

441675.d:
최대 기력과 분노가 20만큼 증가합니다.

광포한 재생력이 최대 생명력을 10%만큼 추가로 증가시킵니다.

441678.d:
무쇠가죽과 광포한 재생력이 표범 변신 상태일 때도 지속됩니다.

곰에서 표범으로 변신할 때 6초 동안 곰 변신 상태의 방어도와 생명력을 80%만큼 유지합니다.

곰 변신 후 6초 동안 8초에 걸쳐 받는 피해의 10%를 회복합니다.

441824.d:
찢어발기기가 8초 동안 민첩성을 8%만큼, 무쇠가죽으로 증가하는 방어도를 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

전투 시작 후 처음으로 사용하는 호랑이의 분노가 다음 흉포한 이빨을 찢어발기기로 전환시킵니다.

1243807.m: 특성 · 기력 25 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 표범 변신 필요
1243807.d:
분노에 찬 광란을 방출해 전방의 대상에게 5회 점멸해 주위 모든 적을 할퀴어 (전투력의 15.5%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 추가로 6초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 31.08%) * 6 / 2]의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 5점을 생성합니다.

1261867.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1261867.d:
현재 활성화된 변신 형상에 따라 강력한 비역할 능력을 사용합니다.

인간형:
강화된 급속 성장을 시전하여 대상의 30미터 내에 있는 최대 5명의 부상당한 아군을 7초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 336.7%) * 750 / 100]만큼 치유합니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots that keep Radiant Spellsower walking toward the tank, and kick Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy, 4 sec cast) with Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge).

[광역 피해] Once everything is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits, and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath. Pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec with Improved Barkskin) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove, drop Ursol's Vortex (1 min) under it to hold it with the 50% slow and pull-back. The Druid of the Claw build can stun it with Maim (30 sec) instead.
2: [우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher wraps itself in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108), target it and break the shield with Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) and Ferocious Bite. It is immune to crowd control while shielded, so Incapacitating Roar and Maim will not work.
[차단] One Skull Bash (15 sec) cannot cover both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, so take one and hand the other to another interrupter.
[광역 피해] If the Barkskin (1 min) from pull 1 is back, pop it again for Spouting Floret.
3: [제어] With 12 Lashers in this pull, a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove is dangerous, so if Ursol's Vortex (1 min) from pull 1 is back, drop it under the fleeing Spellsower. The Druid of the Claw build stuns it with Maim.
[차단] Put Skull Bash in the Light Bolt Volley interrupt rotation.
5: [광역 피해] This is the first big pull after the boss, so if Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) are back, use them on the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first, and pop Barkskin for Spouting Floret.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) with Skull Bash.
[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap can be stopped with a stun, so the Druid of the Claw build uses Maim (30 sec). The Wildstalker build has no stun, so step out of the follow-up cone attacks.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Skull Bash. If Skull Bash is free, also kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot.
[제어] With the Druid of the Claw build, stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Maim.

[참고] The two Luminous Thornmaws' Grievous Gash bleed (stacking 48491 Physical every 1 sec) only drops at full health, so when Predatory Swiftness makes Regrowth instant, cast it on the tank to help top them off.
8: [광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
[제어] With the Druid of the Claw build, stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Maim, and when you have room, kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot with Skull Bash.
10: [해제] Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew is a poison that deals 58189 Nature to the whole party every 1.5 sec for 9 sec, and Remove Corruption has an 8 sec cooldown, so you can only clear one player at a time. Clear the healer and low-health players first.
[광역 피해] The adds are cleared first, so use Primal Wrath and Frantic Frenzy on the Lasher pack and save Berserk and Convoke the Spirits for the Potatoad Matriarch you engage afterward.
11: [차단] One Skull Bash (15 sec) cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so take one and leave the rest to the interrupt rotation.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and give the tank an instant Regrowth (Predatory Swiftness) while Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash bleed is on them.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so use Berserk and Convoke the Spirits together with Tiger's Fury. If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap, add Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) to Barkskin.
[우선 처치] Among the six Lightgorged Lashers, target the ones wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield and break it with Frantic Frenzy and Ferocious Bite. Shielded ones are immune to crowd control.
[차단] Put Skull Bash in the interrupt rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, and drop Ursol's Vortex on one that flees with Call The Grove.

1: [차단] Each Primal Serpent gets its own interrupter, so take one and kick its Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast) with Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge).
[광역 피해] This first pull is 82 count, so once everything is gathered, stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits, and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath.
[제어] If a Ravenous Descendant lives long enough to stack attack speed, the Druid of the Claw build uses Maim (30 sec) with 3+ combo points to stun it for more than 3 sec and reset the stacks.
2: [우선 처치] Pop Tiger's Fury on the Ritual Chieftain and put Rip and Ferocious Bite on it first.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec with Improved Barkskin) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party, then absorbs the next 162029 healing).
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Skull Bash.
3: [차단] All three Primal Serpents walking down behind the pillar must be kicked, so agree on your target before the pull and kick its Piercing Hiss with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] If the Barkskin (1 min) from pull 2 is not back, use Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) for Blood Sacrifice.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull before the first boss (103 count), so if Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) are back, use them with Tiger's Fury and melt the Ritual Chieftain first.
[광역 피해] If Blood Sacrifice lands while the Paralyzing Shots DoT (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec) is out, pop Barkskin, and add Survival Instincts if your health drops hard.
[차단] Kick Piercing Hiss from one of the two Primal Serpents with Skull Bash.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Skull Bash. Always kick the cast that comes right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle.
[제어] If Evolve (6 sec channel, grants a shield and CC immunity on completion) starts while Skull Bash is on cooldown from Mass Envenom, the Druid of the Claw build stops it with Maim.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin (12 sec) for Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec).
8: [광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Rattle, and if the Barkskin from pull 7 is still on its 1 min cooldown, use Survival Instincts.
[제어] The Druid of the Claw build stuns one Bloodletter with Maim so fewer blood pools get dropped.
9: [차단] Kick the near High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Skull Bash and leave the far-left one to a ranged interrupter. Skull Bash is a 13 yd charge, so using it on that one pulls you away from the pack.
[해제] Envenom poison comes from two High Evolutionists, and Remove Corruption has an 8 sec cooldown, so you can clear only one player at a time. Clear the healer and low-health players first.
11: [차단] Each of the four High Evolutionists gets its own interrupter, so take one and kick its Mass Envenom with Skull Bash. The Druid of the Claw build stops the same one's Evolve with Maim.
[해제] Envenom poison pours out of four casters, so use Remove Corruption (8 sec) on cooldown on the healer and low-health players.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so use Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) here, and add Berserk and Convoke the Spirits if they are back.
[광역 피해] When the eggs burst together at the Infest stack spot, each one deals 69827 Nature within 8 yd and they overlap, so pop Barkskin right before they burst.
[제어] If the Hatchlings from the eggs scatter, drop Ursol's Vortex (1 min) under the tank to hold them within 8 yd.
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so put Skull Bash (15 sec) in the interrupt rotation.

[우선 처치] To keep the six Living Venoms from dying at once, do not use Primal Wrath or Convoke the Spirits in this pull. Build combo points on Ula'tek's Chosen with Shred and put Rip and Ferocious Bite on it.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every 1 sec for 9 sec), and during it the Druid of the Claw build stuns a Blade of the Altar with Maim.
14: [광역 피해] If the Barkskin (1 min) from pull 13 is not back, use Survival Instincts for Toxic Surge.
[우선 처치] As in pull 13, hold your AoE so the Living Venoms do not burst together, and kill Ula'tek's Chosen first with single-target damage. Put Skull Bash in the Mass Envenom interrupt rotation.
15: [차단] Kick Piercing Hiss from one of the two Primal Serpents with Skull Bash.
[참고] This pull has no Ritual Chieftain or Ula'tek's Chosen, so clear it with Frantic Frenzy and Primal Wrath and save Berserk and Convoke the Spirits for pull 16.
16: [광역 피해] This last pull puts the most strain on the healer, so stack Berserk, Convoke the Spirits and Tiger's Fury to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge.
[광역 피해] If Blood Sacrifice from the two Ritual Chieftains overlaps Toxic Surge, add Survival Instincts to Barkskin.
[차단] Put Skull Bash in the interrupt rotation for Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom.

1: [광역 피해] Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard are pulled together with Bloodlust, so stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits, and put Rip and Ferocious Bite on the Bribed Captain, which carries the Deep Corruption aura, first.
[해제] Take the poison dispel job and clear Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison stacks with Remove Corruption (8 sec), starting with the tank.
2: [차단] Each Seductive Sayaad gets its own interrupter, so take one and kick its Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge).
[회피] Felwyrms explode for 193965 Fire within 4 yd on death, so when you kill them together with Primal Wrath, step back right before the last hit.
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast, so use Remove Corruption (8 sec) on the tank on cooldown.
5: [우선 처치] Massive Felwyrm dies first in this pull, so line up Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) on it.
[회피] When the dying Massive Felwyrm starts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), get 10 yd out right away as melee. Use Dash if you are far in.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and CC immunity for 1 min) with Skull Bash, and if it gets through, remove the enrage with Soothe (10 sec).
[회피] When you see Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd), step 12 yd out and come back.
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and Demonic Frenzy starts pulsing 29095 Fire to the party every 1 sec, pop Tiger's Fury and burn it down with Ferocious Bite.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split among everyone within 4 yd) is a curse, so clear it at once with Remove Corruption.
[광역 피해] If you are the Drain Life target, pop Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) or Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec).
[해제] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Skull Bash and remove any enrage that gets through with Soothe. Clean up the eight Demon Flies together with Primal Wrath.
10: [차단] Kick the first Health Funnel (channel) from one of the two Fel Invokers with Skull Bash.
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, pop Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy and burn it down with Ferocious Bite. Step 12 yd out when you see the Whirlwind cast.
11: [우선 처치] To keep Felmaster Lucsei from getting more than three Blade Dances out, use Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) with Tiger's Fury on Lucsei if they are back.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), and use Survival Instincts for the second Blade Dance if Barkskin is down.
13: [광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone).
[해제] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Skull Bash and remove any enrage that gets through with Soothe.
[광역 피해] Once the mobs dragged onto the imp pack are gathered, spread Rip to all six Unleashed Imps as well with Primal Wrath.
14: [해제] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Skull Bash and remove any enrage that gets through with Soothe.
[차단] If Skull Bash is free, also kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.
15: [해제] Clear Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom at once with Remove Corruption.
[광역 피해] If you are the Drain Life target, pop Survival Instincts or Barkskin. Do not touch Shivan Punisher while the Warlock is dragged back and killed first.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem must die within two of its AoE casts, so stack Berserk, Convoke the Spirits and Tiger's Fury on it.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for the first Defiled Slam and Survival Instincts for the second.
[차단] Kick Health Funnel from one of the two Fel Invokers with Skull Bash.

1: [해제] When the two Territorial Matriarchs enrage with Mother's Wrath (50% more damage, stacking), remove it right away with Soothe (10 sec). With a 10 sec cooldown, if both enrage together, clear the first one and follow with the next Soothe as soon as it is back.
[해제] Starvation Effigy's Insatiable Hunger is a curse that lowers max health by 15%, so Remove Corruption (8 sec) can clear it. Clear players at 2 stacks first.

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull, so stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath. When Starvation Effigy appears, swap and break it first.
2: [차단] Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast) both need kicks, so spend Skull Bash (15 sec) on Healing Breeze first.
[해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe and clear the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Skull Bash.
[해제] When Territorial Matriarch enrages at low health, remove it with Soothe, and clear the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption.
4: [해제] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Soothe, and clear the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Corruption before it reaches 2 stacks.
[참고] Give an instant Regrowth from Predatory Swiftness to players stacking Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every 1 sec for 10 sec, stacking) from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Skull Bash.
[해제] If Territorial Matriarch enrages while the tank drags this pack to the boss spot, remove it with Soothe.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, so once the pack is gathered in the corner, use Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) with Tiger's Fury.
[해제] Remove the two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath one at a time with Soothe (10 sec). A late Soothe sharply raises the physical damage the tank takes.
[차단] Take one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders and kick its Healing Breeze with Skull Bash.
8: [해제] Remove the two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath one at a time with Soothe.
[우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler has Rumbling Ward up, the whole party takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so swap and break the shield with Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) and Ferocious Bite.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull, so if Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are back, use them with Tiger's Fury during Bloodlust.
[차단] Two interrupters each take one Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast), so kick one with Skull Bash.
[우선 처치] Break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield with Ferocious Bite and Frantic Frenzy.
10: [차단] Kick one Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are down after the Bloodlust pull, so keep Primal Wrath rolling with Tiger's Fury (30 sec) and Frantic Frenzy.
11: [회피] Avatar of Determination's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 4 sec stun and 387930 Physical within 12 yd) easily catches melee, so step 12 yd out when you see the cast. If you cannot, pop Barkskin, which works while stunned.
[우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first, then break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield with Frantic Frenzy and Ferocious Bite.
13: [차단] Kick Arc Lightning (4 sec cast) from one of the two Stormbound Mystics with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo stacks armor-ignoring Physical damage, so pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec).
14: [해제] When Bonded Beasttamer enrages itself and its pet with Bestial Wrath (25% more damage for 10 sec), Soothe the pet fixated on a party member first.
[우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems right away with Ferocious Bite, and kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] If the third Bloodlust goes here, use Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with it. If the group saves Bloodlust for Loa Speaker Nanea, save the 2 min cooldowns for Nanea too.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns casting Primal Echo, so use Barkskin for the first Echo and Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) for the next.
[차단] Kick Arc Lightning from one of the two Stormbound Mystics with Skull Bash.
[해제] Remove Bonded Beasttamer's Bestial Wrath with Soothe.
16: [차단] Put Skull Bash in the interrupt rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] When the three Volatile Totems appear, swap and break them together with Frantic Frenzy and Primal Wrath unless Nanea is around 10% health. If Bloodlust goes here, stack Berserk and Convoke the Spirits to finish her by the second totem wave.

1: [차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd), so take the second kick with Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge). If someone else has it, kick one Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt instead.

[광역 피해] This pull drags the whole first hallway up to the Magi with Bloodlust, so once the mobs are gathered in the room, stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath.

[해제] When Feral Saberon raises nearby mobs' melee haste by 20% with Feral Rage, it is an enrage, so remove it with Soothe (10 sec). If you are the Null Eruption target, move out of the group and pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the three Orb of Disruption orbs, swap at once. If the orbs are bunched in front of you, Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) hops between them 5 times, and if they are far, close in with Dash.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for the long Thundering Storm party AoE, and if Barkskin fades before it ends, follow up with Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec).
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 count, so if Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) are back, use them with Tiger's Fury and spread Rip with Primal Wrath. Pop Barkskin for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec channel, 87284 Nature every 2 sec).
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned by Concussion, it takes 20% more physical damage for 5 sec, so as a mostly physical spec, dump Tiger's Fury and Ferocious Bite into those 5 sec.
[해제] Remove the five Feral Saberons' Feral Rage enrage one at a time with Soothe (10 sec).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so save Skull Bash for it.

[광역 피해] This is the first pull after the boss, so if Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are back, line them up on Watchful Harrower. Pop Barkskin when you join the Sky Strike (5 sec cast) circle to split the damage.
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer raises its Brutal Slams shield, each slam hits the party 10% harder, so break the shield with Tiger's Fury, Frantic Frenzy, and any Berserk and Convoke the Spirits you have left.
[광역 피해] If Brutal Slams overlaps Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, add Survival Instincts to Barkskin.
[차단] Kick Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Skull Bash.
8: [우선 처치] When a low-health mob gets the icon for Devouring Brutalizer's Devour (9 sec cast), swap at once and finish it with Ferocious Bite.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Skull Bash. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void only when Skull Bash is free.
[광역 피해] This is a cooldown pull, so use Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury, and pop Barkskin for Dreadbellow (29095 Shadow every 1 sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Skull Bash.
[우선 처치] Finish the mob with the Devour icon first with Ferocious Bite, and clean up the ten Scavenging Siphoids together with Primal Wrath and Frantic Frenzy.
[광역 피해] If the Barkskin (1 min) from pull 8 is not back, use Survival Instincts for Dreadbellow.
10: [우선 처치] Finish the mob with the Devour icon first with Ferocious Bite, and when Watchful Harrower is chained in as the Brutalizer nears death, line up Berserk and Convoke the Spirits on it if they are back.
[광역 피해] If you split Sky Strike while the Dreadbellow DoT is still ticking, add Survival Instincts to Barkskin.
[해제] Remove the two Feral Saberons' Feral Rage enrage with Soothe.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull, so Bloodlust goes here. Drag the two Animated Guardians to the Shadow-Borne Champion pack, and once the mobs are gathered, stack Tiger's Fury, Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath.

[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec) for the first cast of Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd), and if Barkskin is down for the next cast, use Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec).
[해제] When Shadow-Borne Champion raises its damage by 150% with Ancestral Fury, it is an enrage, so remove it right away with Soothe (10 sec).
2: [차단] Put Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge) in the kick rotation for Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow followed by a 12 sec curse DoT). Remove a missed curse DoT from party members with Remove Corruption (8 sec).
[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull, but if you used Berserk and Convoke the Spirits on pull 1 they are not back yet, so dump your damage with Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy (45 sec).
[해제] Remove Shadow-Borne Champion's Ancestral Fury enrage with Soothe, and pop the returned Barkskin for Shadow Whirlwind.
4: [차단] When Queen Wasi's pack wakes up, kick Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) first with Skull Bash, and kick Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending in the kick rotation.
[해제] When Queen Patlaa raises her own and nearby mobs' speed by 25% with Bestial Berserk, it is an enrage, so remove it with Soothe (10 sec).

[광역 피해] After the tank has aggro, line up Tiger's Fury, Berserk and Convoke the Spirits on the hardest pack, King A'akul's. If you take Blood Drain (164870 Physical) while bleeding from Sudden Rupture, pop Barkskin, and add Survival Instincts if the bleeds stack up.
5: [광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party). If you use Bloodlust here in a high key, use Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with it.
[해제] Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers is a poison (12 sec DoT, 20% movement slow), so clear affected party members with Remove Corruption, and clear your own slow by re-entering Cat Form.
6: [차단] Take one of the two kicks on the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT) with Skull Bash. Feral cannot remove diseases, so pop Barkskin if it goes through.
7: [차단] Take one kick on the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge on the other side with Skull Bash.
[해제] Clear the Putrid Seekers poison DoT from the eight Embalming Fluids with Remove Corruption, and once the mobs are gathered, spread Rip to all of them with Primal Wrath.
9: [차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop, so kick one's Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) or Spectral Bolt with Skull Bash. Hex is a curse, so free the affected ally right away with Remove Corruption.
[제어] Stop the other Phantom Hex Priest's cast with Maim (Druid of the Claw build, 1 sec stun per combo point).
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin when Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (29095 Physical every 1 sec for 12 sec) stack up.
10: [광역 피해] In a four-Bloodlust route, the third Bloodlust goes on this pull, so line up Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury on Ghostly Brute.
[차단] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Skull Bash, and free a hexed ally with Remove Corruption.
[회피] When Ghostly Brute casts Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up), get out at once with Dash or Tiger Dash (Druid of the Claw build).
12: [회피] When Shadow of Zul's Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec) targets you, use Dash to get more than 20 yd from the group and pop Barkskin.
[참고] Bloodlust goes on the start of the next boss, Dazar, so save Berserk and Convoke the Spirits here and kill it with Tiger's Fury and Ferocious Bite.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield and CC immunity on an ally every 3 sec) with Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge).

[우선 처치] This big pull gathers everything up to the entrance hallway, so line up Tiger's Fury, Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion) and Convoke the Spirits (2 min) on Primal Juggernaut and spread Rip to every target with Primal Wrath. Pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT).
[제어] When the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high, stun one Deepstone Earthshaper with Maim (Druid of the Claw build, 1 sec stun per combo point).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Skull Bash.
[우선 처치] Kill the CC-immune Primal Juggernaut first with Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy (45 sec), and pop Barkskin for Excavating Blast.
3: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Skull Bash.

[우선 처치] Defier Draghar is a CC-immune miniboss, so if Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are back, use them with Tiger's Fury, and pop Barkskin when the party Fire damage from each Steel Barrage strike piles up.
5: [차단] Kicks go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, so put Skull Bash on Cinderbolt.
[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be kicked, so stop it with a Maim stun (Druid of the Claw build).
[회피] When Blazebound Destroyer starts Burnout (20 yd explosion) as it dies, get 20 yd away with Dash or Tiger Dash (Druid of the Claw build), since Feral is melee.
6: [광역 피해] At 17 and above, Bloodlust goes on Flamegullet at 50%, so pop Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury then and kill it fast.

[광역 피해] When Flamegullet stacks Molten Blood below 50% (48491 Fire within 60 yd every 3 sec, 15% more per cast), pop Barkskin, and if Barkskin fades before it ends, follow up with Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec).
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Maim (Druid of the Claw build).
7: [차단] Kick one of the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno party Fire damage, and use Dash to get 20 yd out of Burnout when the Destroyer dies.
8: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Skull Bash, and stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Maim (Druid of the Claw build).
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Inferno, and when Burnout starts, use Dash to get 20 yd away.
10: [광역 피해] Once the six Storm Warriors are gathered, spread Rip to all of them with Primal Wrath and cleave them down with Frantic Frenzy.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin when Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec) targets you.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Maim (Druid of the Claw build).
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Skull Bash.
[광역 피해] This stretch is chain-pulled without stopping, so if the Barkskin from pull 10 is not back, use Survival Instincts when Lightning Torrent targets you.
12: [우선 처치] High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health) must break fast, so dump Tiger's Fury, Frantic Frenzy and any returned Berserk and Convoke the Spirits into the shield. In high keys where the team lusts on Ryvati, use them with Bloodlust here.
[광역 피해] While the shield is up, the party takes 29095 Nature every 1 sec, so pop Barkskin. Even if the shield detonates and stuns you for 4 sec, Barkskin can be used while stunned.

1: [우선 처치] Kill the CC-immune Sandfury Stonefist first, so dump Tiger's Fury, Berserk (2 min, Berserk: Heart of the Lion), Convoke the Spirits (2 min) and Frantic Frenzy (45 sec) into it.
[차단] Put Skull Bash (15 sec, 13 yd charge) in the kick rotation for the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt, and always kick Lightning Bolt while Stonefist is casting Ground Pound (4 sec cast).
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin (1 min, 12 sec) for Ground Pound (156627 Physical within 60 yd plus a knockback).
2: [해제] The two Shrouded Fangs' Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun plus 96982 Nature every 1 sec) is a poison, so free the affected party member right away with Remove Corruption (8 sec).
[차단] Kick the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Skull Bash, and pop Barkskin for Stonefist's Ground Pound.
4: [우선 처치] The longer Sand-Sworn Rider lives, the more Swarming Krolusks add up, so kill it first with Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Skull Bash, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Maim (Druid of the Claw build, 1 sec stun per combo point).
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull on the route (91), so if Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are back, line them up with Tiger's Fury on Sand-Sworn Rider and Krolusk Matriarch and spread Rip with Primal Wrath.
[차단] Lightning Bolt kills when it lands on someone hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin, so never miss your Skull Bash on the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin when you take Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed (38793 Physical every 1 sec for 6 sec).
6: [차단] One person is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient), so take it with Skull Bash. If it goes through, it is a curse, so free the target with Remove Corruption.
[차단] If Skull Bash is free, kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt.
7: [해제] With three Poisonous Vipers, Cytotoxin lands on several people, so use Remove Corruption (8 sec) on cooldown and clear the Venom Bolt target first.
[차단] Kick Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Skull Bash, and clear an Addle Mind curse that lands with Remove Corruption.
9: [광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole party), and add Survival Instincts (3 min, 50% damage reduction for 6 sec) if both Nimbuses' Release Charges come back to back.
[차단] Keep kicking Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Skull Bash even while Release Charge goes off.
10: [차단] The two Imbued Stormcallers are stopped before gathering the rest, so kick one's Lightning Bolt with Skull Bash and stop the other with Maim (Druid of the Claw build).
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Release Charge, and if the Barkskin from pull 9 is not back, use Survival Instincts. Clean up the four Static Anomalies together with Primal Wrath.
12: [차단] Kick the tank-side Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel with Skull Bash, and lock down the far-side Disruptor with Maim (Druid of the Claw build).
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT), and dump Tiger's Fury and Frantic Frenzy into the Orb Watcher.
13: [차단] Keep kicking Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption with Skull Bash until the orb reaches 100%.
[광역 피해] Pop Barkskin for Caustic Stomp, and if Berserk and Convoke the Spirits are back, use them on the Orb Watcher.
14: [차단] The CC-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked, so save Skull Bash for it.

[제어] Hold the four healer-chasing Faithless Tormentors in one spot with Ursol's Vortex (1 min, 50% slow and pull-back for 10 sec), and in the Druid of the Claw build push them away from the healer with Typhoon.
